symbols.reasoning: Up drops legacy unique plaintext PIN index, makes Pin nullable/unbounded, and adds nullable PinHash/PinIterations/PinSalt. It performs no hashing/backfill SQL or helper invocation. This is a transition schema requiring separately verified data conversion before subsequent drop, not evidence every existing account now has usable verifier. Removing equality uniqueness is consistent with per-user salted hashes but shifts collision enforcement to app.

symbols.reasoning: Down drops all three verifier fields then restores required bounded plaintext Pin default empty and unique PIN index. Hashes cannot reconstruct original PIN; rows with NULL/duplicate empty values or oversized text can make reverse constraint application fail. This is neither credential recovery nor reversible cryptographic migration; no data transformation or DB rollback executed.
